hero.role: Full-stack developer building web apps and AI tools.
hero.pitch: Computer science graduate from TU Berlin. I build full-stack web apps and AI tooling such as agents and MCP servers, and ship them with CI/CD, tests and Docker.
hero.location: Based near Berlin · open to full-stack, software and AI tooling roles

projects.title: Projects
projects.lead: Both apps run live on this domain. They use free hosting, so the first visit after a quiet spell can take up to a minute while the server wakes up. This page starts waking them as soon as it loads.

omnistore.summary: B2B inventory management for teams, with role-based access, invites and Stripe subscriptions.
highlights: NestJS backend, React frontend and PostgreSQL database
CI/CD with GitHub Actions: automated tests and automatic deployment to Render
MCP server that lets an AI model read the database, test migrations in an isolated Docker container and deploy them after human approval
Stripe subscriptions: the subscription workflow built by hand, cancellation and plan changes added with AI agents

tracker.name: Application Tracker
tracker.summary: Track job applications from saved to offer, with a status workflow and full history.
highlights: REST API with session-based authentication, CSRF protection and per-user data isolation
Status transitions with optimistic locking, plus filtering and pagination
Integration tests in a GitHub Actions pipeline that publishes Docker images

security.name: International security contest
security.text: Built a web service with deliberately vulnerable JavaScript endpoints and a Python checker, then found and exploited vulnerabilities in other teams' services.

thesis.name: Bachelor thesis
thesis.text: How the output function (SoftMax or Sigmoid) affects accuracy and uncertainty in neural networks that segment Earth observation imagery. Accuracy was comparable, and calibrated SoftMax networks were not overconfident.

os.name: Operating systems lab
os.text: A small operating system for the Raspberry Pi, written in C and assembler.

algo.name: Algorithms lab
algo.text: An algorithm that swaps two image segments while keeping the contrast along their borders as low as possible.

frontend.name: Frontend course
frontend.text: Team projects in groups of three, ending with Whisker's Warehouse Leap, a browser jumping game.
